description: Checks an image or audio file for a Markproof watermark and a C2PA manifest, and reports whether its signature is valid and whether it matches a record in this Markproof account. Use it to confirm a file is marked before publishing, or to inspect a file of unknown origin. Counts as one API call.

path.description: Path to the local image or audio file to check. Uploads are limited to about 4.5 MB.

url.description: Public https URL of the file, instead of path. Use it for files over 4.5 MB (up to 25 MB), e.g. marked audio, which is WAV.

name: verify_file
title: Check a file for AI marking
